subject.title: fix(cron): bound cron quarantine sidecar file reads

question: Should cron quarantine overflow recovery silently retain only five archives and delete older recovery artifacts, or should cron use a different owner-approved bounded-retention policy?
rationale: The cap prevents unbounded disk growth, but choosing which recovery artifacts can be deleted is product and upgrade policy rather than a mechanical correctness decision.

options.title: Approve five-file retention
options.body: Accept silent pruning of the oldest archive once more than five cron quarantine recovery archives exist.

options.title: Specify the retention contract before merge
options.body: Define the intended recovery-data lifetime, operator visibility, and bounded-storage behavior, then align this PR to that contract.

recommendation.title: Specify the retention contract before merge
recommendation.body: Define the intended recovery-data lifetime, operator visibility, and bounded-storage behavior, then align this PR to that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The available discussion evidence directly routes the retention-policy question to this reviewer, though code-history ownership could not be confirmed.
